_comment: CANONICAL list of deployed Supabase Edge Functions on the shared project. fethi-web (the schema owner) appends a function slug here in the SAME PR that deploys it, then copies this file into fethi-mobile/src/shared/types/ alongside database.types.ts + applied-scrs.json. Edge Functions do NOT appear in database.types.ts (only tables/views/RPCs do), so this manifest is the contract the mobile coordination gate (scripts/check-scr.mjs) reads to block consumer tasks whose dispatch function isn't live yet. See docs/db/COORDINATION.md and docs/WEB-BACKEND-SYNC.md.
